mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an active monetary tightening cycle that raises discount rates for equity valuation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS rising by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 4.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low unemployment (UNRATE < 3.5%) and weak payroll growth (PAYEMS monthly change < 100 thousand) signals an impending labor market slowdown that reduces corporate hiring and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS growth < 100.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), a rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals insufficient monetary policy to control inflation, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS rises by ≥0.25pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer demand and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in less than 40% of instances when HOUST is rising by at least 0.5% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below its 12-month moving average, it signals a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) are rising but housing starts (HOUST) are falling, it signals a shift in consumer spending from durable goods (housing) to non-durables, which may indicate a weakening economy and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST growth < -0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong economic growth (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), a rising CPI (CPIAUCSL) signals that the Fed will tighten policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: In strong economic growth regimes (GDPC1 quarterly growth > 2.0%), SPX 60d forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL rises by ≥0.25pp.
